preamble: Documentary photography, available light only, handheld 35mm. Natural skin tones, honest imperfect surfaces, slight motion in the frame. Muted realistic grade, no colour cast, visible grain. Candid, unposed, nobody looking at camera. Absolutely not stock-photo styling, no fake smiles, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: Empty living room in a new-build apartment. Camera at chest height standing in the doorway, looking straight at the far wall. One large window centered on the far wall, a radiator below it, ceiling visible at the top, floor filling the lower third of the frame. Soft daylight from the window only, no artificial light. BEFORE renovation: bare grey concrete walls with rough plaster patches, dusty cement screed floor, electrical wires hanging out of the walls and from the ceiling, an aluminium stepladder standing to the left of the window, dusty window glass, a few cardboard scraps on the floor. The lower left third of the frame is plain empty floor with nothing on it, large empty space for text. No people, no text, no signs.
